page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server operating on the KVM hypervisor. Driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, this instance features 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Hyper-Threading technology. The system is equipped with 64 GB of memory, yielding a compute-oriented ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware capabilities include AVX, AVX-512, and AVX512_VNNI instruction set extensions, along with AES cryptography support and a cache hierarchy consisting of 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 35 MB L3 cache. The server includes no local disk storage and contains zero GPUs. Network capabilities feature a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate balanced parallel execution alongside lower single-core throughput. On stress-ng tests, multi-core CPU performance achieves a score of 27,991.83, while single-core performance registers at 1,312.99. Single-threaded gzip compression records 22.8 GB/sec, placing it in a lower percentile tier. Multi-threaded decompression via bzip3 reaches 131.46 GB/sec. In synthetic evaluations, the instance records a PassMark CPU score of 26,869.48 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 10,040.0. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 104.33 GB/sec, while web application benchmarks report 26.78 million Redis SET operations per second and static web serving throughput of 19.2 GB/sec.

From a cost efficiency standpoint, the hardware configuration prioritizes vCPU density per unit of memory, making it effective for parallel processing tasks where high memory capacity is unnecessary. A primary operational tradeoff is the requirement for external network storage due to the lack of ephemeral local storage, combined with moderate single-core benchmark results. The instance is suited for multi-threaded software compilation, parallel batch processing, Redis caching layers, static web serving, and microservice backend deployment.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs, 16 physical cores, and 64 GB of memory, powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor on x86_64 architecture. Hardware features include 35 MB L3 cache, AVX-512 vector extensions, and AES acceleration, with no local disk storage or GPU acceleration attached. Baseline network throughput is 10 Gbps. Benchmark data indicates solid multi-core performance, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 26,869.48, a Geekbench multi-core score of 10,040.0, and Redis SET throughput of 26.78 million operations per second. However, single-core execution and single-threaded gzip compression reflect lower percentile performance. By offering high compute core density relative to memory capacity, this instance is suited for multi-threaded backend tasks, web serving, software compilation pipelines, and in-memory caching platforms reliant on external network storage.

bullet_points: 32 dedicated vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY at 2.5 GHz.
64 GB system memory delivering a compute-focused 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
